instruction.text: Look at the modal verb and select the most appropriate adverb.

atoms.b: We ((++definitely possibly)) will come back here on holiday.
One should ((++regularly potentially)) go to the doctors for a check-up.
She ((++probably always)) ought to pick up another hobby, as she’s always bored.
One must ((++never sometimes)) rely on luck alone for success.
They ((++obviously maybe)) have to improve if they want to be promoted next season.
It will ((++always maybe)) be worth it to ask questions when you’re not sure about something.
